mandatory: Exactly three cards of identical size: card 1 soft amber, card 2 soft blue, card 3 light grey
Exactly four red chips: one in card 1, one in card 2, two in card 3
Each card has exactly one 'Misses:' heading, directly above its red chip(s), left-aligned, bold near-black #1F2328
The red chips in all three cards sit at the same height; card 3's two chips stack
'm0_stepN.txt' is monospace on one line with the capital N kept
Author and holds lines are semibold near-black, never grey
The title reads exactly 'Three records, three authors', bold, top-left, one line
Every string in text_exact appears exactly as many times as stated (once unless stated), spelled exactly as written
prohibitions: NO row labels such as 'Written by' or 'Holds' standing alone; the only standalone label is 'Misses:'
NO command text, shell syntax, flags or flag values of any kind (no 'gcloud', 'curl', 'bq', 'agy -p', '--', '$', '|', 'stream-json')
NO URLs, hostnames or file paths other than the file names listed in text_exact
NO project IDs, project numbers, regions, or email addresses (nothing containing '@', 'projects/' or 'iam.gserviceaccount.com')
NO logos of any kind, including Google, Google Cloud, Gemini or Antigravity logos
NO people, faces, hands, silhouettes, robots, mascots or characters
NO text that is not listed in text_exact: no extra labels, numbers, step numbers, captions, legend, footnote or source note
NO identifier (file name or login name) broken across two lines
NO word broken at a hyphen
NO grey or faint text for any label; every label is semibold near-black #1F2328
